content.html: Cobalt is a metal. Cobalt is between copper and iron in the reactivity series. The mineral spherocobaltite contains the compound cobalt(II) carbonate and no other metal ions. Cobalt(II) carbonate is insoluble in water and reacts with dilute acids to form an aqueous solution of a salt. Describe how you would obtain a sample of cobalt metal starting with a large lump of spherocobaltite. You have access to all normal laboratory apparatus and chemicals.
